title: fast: --base option to replay a merged PR without a soft reset
body: fast cannot replay a merged PR: merge-base(HEAD, origin/main) equals HEAD, so it reports 'no changed files'. Replaying #259 needed a detached worktree plus 'git reset --soft <PR base>'. Outcome: 'npm run fast -- --base <sha>' diffs against the given base; a test replays a deleted-file commit through --base and gets FAIL without a reset.
